description: Legal scope of Korean licensed professions — 세무사 (tax), 공인회계사 (accounting/audit), 공인노무사 (labor), 행정사 (administrative), 법무사 (court documents/registry), 보험계리사·손해사정사·보험설계사 (insurance actuarial, loss adjusting, registered sales), 관세사 (customs), 변리사 (patents/trademarks), 감정평가사 (appraisal), 공인중개사 (real estate brokerage) — with the statute article, the work a non-licensed person may not do as a business, the title-protection rules, free public help lines, and a who-can-do-what matrix (incl. 변호사). Use it to tell users what an AI legal-information assistant may and may not do, and when to hand off to a licensed professional.

domain.description: tax = 세금(세무사), accounting = 회계·장부(공인회계사), labor = 노동(공인노무사), admin = 행정(행정사), court = 등기·법원 서류(법무사), insurance = 보험(보험계리사·손해사정사·등록 설계사), customs = 관세·통관(관세사), ip = 특허·상표(변리사), appraisal = 감정평가·보상(감정평가사), realty = 부동산 중개(공인중개사), building = 건축·인허가(건축사), health = 보건·의료 이용(의료인·약사), family = 가사·이혼(변호사), welfare = 복지급여(사회복지사, 대행은 행정사), consumer = 소비자·온라인 구매(한국소비자원·변호사), privacy = 개인정보(유출 72시간 통지·신고, 처리방침; 보호위원회·KISA·변호사), traffic = 교통사고(12대 중과실·보험 특례·정부보장사업; 변호사·손해사정사). Omit for all six.
